title: A Study of Zolpidem Tartrate Sublingual Tablet in Adult Patients With Insomnia
brief_summary: The purpose of the study is to evaluate sleep onset following administration of zolpidem tartrate sublingual tablet (Intermezzo) versus placebo in adult insomnia patients.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adults with history of sleeplessness

Exclusion Criteria:

* Allergic to investigational drug
* Any conditions and medications that may interfere with study drug evaluation
